title: os dev --seed-admin on an email-verification-armed boot logs ERROR "TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: no templateLoader configured on EmailService" — the seed sign-up fires sendVerificationEmail before plugin-email wires its template loader
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a product defect with a named landing point. **Reach:** public CLI entry, `objectstack dev --seed-admin` (the default) on a boot with email verification required. It was measured on two separate fresh-DB boots: `OS_AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=true`, and `OS_AUTH_AUDIENCE_POSTURE=open`, which forces verification. Each printed the error once at boot.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:identity` / `plugin-email` execution seat. Fix the ordering, or skip the send. Either:
- the dev seed does not fire `sendOnSignUp` for an identity it immediately marks verified; or
- the verification send waits for or tolerates the template loader that `EmailServicePlugin.start` installs, instead of throwing into better-auth's background-task logger.

## What happens

On a stock showcase boot with verification armed, the boot log shows this line before the server is ready:

```
ERROR [Better Auth]: Failed to run background task: Error: TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: no templateLoader configured on EmailService
    at EmailService.resolveAndRenderTemplate (plugin-email/dist/index.mjs)
    at EmailService.sendTemplate (plugin-email/dist/index.mjs)
    at Object.sendVerificationEmail (plugin-auth/dist/index.mjs)
```

- **Cost:** every verification-armed dev boot opens with a red ERROR and a stack trace for a send nobody needed. The seeded admin is marked `emailVerified: true`.
- That verification send leaves no `sys_email` row.
- Any identity created through better-auth before `EmailServicePlugin.start` runs would lose its verification mail the same way.
- Later sends on the same boot (sign-up, resend) render and persist fine, so the window is boot-time only.

## Reproduction

At `2034975a`, from `examples/app-showcase`:

1. `OS_AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=true OS_PORT=P pnpm exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p P -d file:/tmp/fresh/data.db` on a fresh DB.
2. Read the boot log. The ERROR line above appears once, before the serving line.
3. Contrast: the same boot without the verification variable prints no such line.

**Expected:** no ERROR on a healthy boot. The seed either sends nothing, or sends successfully once templates resolve.
**Actual:** the seed's verification send throws `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` into better-auth's background-task error log.

## Mechanism

- The dev seed (`packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts`, `--seed-admin`, default on) signs the admin up in-process. With `emailVerification.sendOnSignUp`, better-auth runs `sendVerificationEmail` (plugin-auth) as a background task.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts:1315`: `resolveAndRenderTemplate` throws when `options.templateLoader` is unset.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts` (about lines 386 and 629–638) wires persistence and `setTemplateLoader(...)` only in `start`, so a send issued before that has no loader.

## Dedupe

- MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND no templateLoader configured on EmailService seed-admin verification email boot` → 2 hits: #22062 (the boot sweep rewriting templates) and #21785 (template overlay revert). Neither is this ordering error.
- Dedupe words: TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND seed-admin; no templateLoader configured boot error; sendOnSignUp before email plugin start.

QA-source: #23943 · identity-auth.email-verification-loop · negative 1
